$comment: GATING CORRECTION. Resolves a logical contradiction between two frozen protocols. Normative over both. Neither referenced artifact is edited, so no downstream digest changes.

why_a_correction_artifact_rather_than_tw.reason: one_allocation_dose_generation.json's digest is embedded as a CONST in the binding protocol (protocol_sha256, two sites) and referenced by generation_settings.json and qwen_config_identity.json. Bumping it cascades through four artifacts and reissues five digests, each a transcription risk, at the moment Engineer 3 is wiring against them.
why_a_correction_artifact_rather_than_tw.cost_accepted: A reader must consult this artifact alongside the two it corrects. That seam is real.
why_a_correction_artifact_rather_than_tw.recommendation: Inline this correction and the generation_settings manifest extension at the next MAJOR revision of the binding protocol, and retire this file then. Do not let the seam accumulate a third layer.

the_contradiction.clause_a: The bound generation manifest's commit must STRICTLY PRECEDE the selection-record commit. (binding v1.1.0, chronology link 2.)
the_contradiction.clause_b: Each manifest files[] entry carries selection_status, described as 'stamped after selection'. (binding v1.1.0 files.item; one_allocation ADDITION_3.labelling.)
the_contradiction.why_they_cannot_both_hold: A record whose bytes are committed before an event cannot contain that event's outcome. Stamping selection_status would rewrite the manifest, changing its bytes, which invalidates both source_sha256 and computed_at_commit. Either the chain breaks or the field is permanently unfillable. There is no implementation that satisfies both clauses.
the_contradiction.principle: A record required to predate an event may not encode that event's result. The two clauses were mutually exclusive from the moment both were written.
the_contradiction.caught_before: Any real manifest existed. No data migration is required.

RULING.manifest_is_immutable_pre_selection_inve: The bound generation manifest records WHAT WAS GENERATED. It is written once, at transfer, and never rewritten. It may not encode SELECTED, final UNUSED, or any other selection outcome.
RULING.sole_authority_for_selection: causal_validation.selection_records.<direction> is the ONLY authoritative record of selection outcome.
RULING.sealing_survives_intact: The prohibition on using or opening unselected doses is UNCHANGED. Only its ENCODING LOCATION moves, from a mutable manifest field to the immutable selection record. Nothing about the seal weakens.

struck_and_replaced_clauses.disposition: STRUCK. Remove the field from manifest files[] entries entirely.

struck_and_replaced_clauses.verbatim: exactly three doses carry selection_status SELECTED; the remaining doses' files carry UNUSED_FOR_SELECTION_OR_CLAIM.
struck_and_replaced_clauses.disposition: REPLACED by the partition check in selection_record_requirements.partition below.

struck_and_replaced_clauses.verbatim: Each unselected file's manifest entry is stamped UNUSED_FOR_SELECTION_OR_CLAIM.
struck_and_replaced_clauses.disposition: STRUCK. This is the manifest-mutation clause. ADDITION_3's substantive rule -- one file per dose so unselected doses are never opened -- is UNAFFECTED and remains in force.
RELOCATED, not struck. The label now attaches to the selection record's unselected list, not to manifest entries. Every prohibition in sealed_output_rules stands unchanged.
REWORDED, remains a hard stop: 'Opening a file whose dose the selection record lists as unselected.' Only the word 'stamped' implied a manifest stamp; the prohibition itself is untouched.

corrected_manifest_files_item.dose: dose identifier; PROHIBITED on CONTROL entries
corrected_manifest_files_item.control_ref: required on SWEEP and CONFIRMATION; prohibited on CONTROL

no_per_file_pre_selection_flag.rejected: A per-file field that is always true carries no information, costs bytes on roughly 375 entries per direction, and -- worse -- READS as a status that could vary, which invites exactly the post-selection mutation this correction removes.

permitted_alternative.why_this_form_is_acceptable: It describes the KIND of document rather than the state of an entry, so it cannot be partially mutated, and its constancy is honest. Optional; the ancestry check already proves the ordering structurally.

manifest_sha256.semantics: The exact digest of the immutable bound manifest. Promotion checks it equals the digest it RECOMPUTED from the manifest bytes.

unselected.semantics: Every confirmation dose not selected. Under outcome == FAILED this is ALL doses.

partition.rule: The dose set is DERIVED FROM THE MANIFEST -- the distinct dose values across files[] where purpose == CONFIRMATION -- and is never independently asserted by the selection record.
partition.check: selected.values() UNION unselected must equal that derived set EXACTLY: every dose covered exactly once, no duplicates, no dose absent, no dose present that the manifest does not contain.
partition.this_replaces: the struck 'exactly three doses carry selection_status SELECTED' value_check.

distinctness.rule: LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH must name three DISTINCT doses.
distinctness.no_magnitude_ordering_assertion: Do NOT require LOW <= MEDIUM <= HIGH numerically. On the SUPPRESS arm, HIGH is ABLATE, which carries no value, no unit and no unit_source -- a magnitude ordering would be ill-formed on that arm. Distinctness is checkable on both arms; ordering is not.

failed_outcome.shape: outcome FAILED, selected prohibited, unselected = every dose.
failed_outcome.meaning: The direction failed selection. For AMPLIFY that is LOW > HIGH; for SUPPRESS, no dose clearing the relevance drop.
failed_outcome.all_doses_stay_sealed: A FAILED selection seals all five doses permanently. It is a result, not a licence to reopen the set and look for a better dose.

INTERACTION_WITH_BINDING_v1_1_0_NULLITY.question: If SUPPRESS fails, does the promotion document carry a FAILED selection record or a null?
INTERACTION_WITH_BINDING_v1_1_0_NULLITY.ruling: NULL. Binding v1.1.0 requires nullity to mirror across calibration.directions, generation_manifests and selection_records. A failed direction is not published, so selection_records.suppress = null and generation_manifests.suppress = null.
INTERACTION_WITH_BINDING_v1_1_0_NULLITY.where_the_FAILED_record_lives: In the run's immutable inventory, alongside its manifest, preserved and never deleted -- the same retention rule that keeps unselected dose outputs. It is the evidence that SUPPRESS was attempted and failed.
INTERACTION_WITH_BINDING_v1_1_0_NULLITY.prohibition: A FAILED selection record may NEVER be referenced from selection_records.<direction> in a promotion document. Promotion documents carry published directions only.
INTERACTION_WITH_BINDING_v1_1_0_NULLITY.why_this_needs_saying: outcome FAILED exists in the schema so failures are recorded, while binding v1.1.0 requires null in the document. Without stating the split, two implementers would reasonably build contradictory things.

derived_human_readable_view.permitted: May produce a DERIVED, human-readable view joining the immutable manifest with the selection record.
prohibited: having its digest appear in any source_sha256

must_be_unmistakable.requirement: The derived view carries derived: true and NOT_FOR_PROMOTION inside it, and a filename pattern distinct from the bound manifest.
must_be_unmistakable.rule: Promotion ACTIVELY REJECTS any file carrying the derived marker. It does not merely fail to accept it.
must_be_unmistakable.why: A joined view is strictly more readable than the bound manifest, so it is the file a hurried person hands to promotion. Labelling it inline, rather than relying on it being absent from the reference, is the same discipline applied to non-authoritative loader fields.

required_chain_unchanged.strictness: STRICT ancestry on every link. All four commits DISTINCT and reachable. Equal commits are a FAILURE.
required_chain_unchanged.verification: For each consecutive pair (A, B): git merge-base --is-ancestor A B AND A != B.
required_chain_unchanged.per_direction: Verified separately for each non-null direction.
required_chain_unchanged.status: UNCHANGED from binding v1.1.0. This correction removes the clause that made link 2 unsatisfiable, it does not alter the chain.

unchanged: Every identity artifact and every params hash, Gemma and Qwen.
generation_settings.json, including the control arm and the causal-generation order.
One physical manifest per (run_id, configuration, concept_id, pairing_id, direction).
The per-direction maps generation_manifests and selection_records, and their nullity mirroring.
Every sealing prohibition in one_allocation sealed_output_rules.
ADDITION_3's substantive rule: one file per dose, so unselected doses are never opened.
The four binding evidence records plus separate feature_certificate.
hard_stops: A manifest containing selection_status, or any other field encoding a selection outcome.
A manifest rewritten, re-emitted or re-hashed after its computed_at_commit.
A selection record whose manifest_sha256 differs from the digest promotion recomputed.
A selection record failing to partition the manifest's confirmation dose set exactly once.
LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH not naming three distinct doses.
outcome SELECTED with selected absent, or outcome FAILED with selected present.
A FAILED selection record referenced from a promotion document's selection_records.<direction>.
A derived view submitted to promotion, or its digest appearing in any source_sha256.
Opening a file whose dose the selection record lists as unselected.
Any chronology link failing, or any two of the four commits equal.
